## recode 
```{r recode function}
# is_correct
# is_criterr
# is_old
# say_old
# is_fpf 

# HARD CODED batch recoding for all dfs
recode_levels = function(df) {
  
  df_type = unique(df$df_type)
  
  newdf = df %>% 
    mutate(
      # incorrect - correct
      is_correct = case_when(resptype %in% c("Hit","CR")  ~ "Correct",
                             resptype %in% c("FA","Miss") ~ "Incorrect",
                             .default = NA),
      # congruent vs opposite error to bias manipulation; baseline are neutral errors
      is_criterr = case_when(cond=="Lib" & resptype=="FA"    ~ "Congruent",
                             cond=="Con" & resptype=="Miss"  ~ "Congruent",
                             cond=="Lib" & resptype=="Miss"  ~ "Incongruent",
                             cond=="Con" & resptype=="FA"    ~ "Incongruent",
                             cond=="Neutral" & resptype %in% c("FA","Miss") ~ "Neutral", 
                             resptype %in% c("Hit","CR") ~ "Correct",
                             .default = NA),
      # item status
      is_old = case_when(resptype %in% c("Hit","Miss") ~ "Old",
                         resptype %in% c("FA","CR")    ~ "New",
                         .default = NA),
      # response
      say_old = case_when(resptype %in% c("Hit","FA")  ~ "Old",
                          resptype %in% c("CR","Miss") ~ "New",
                          .default = NA)
    )
  
  if (df_type=="feed") {
    newdf = newdf %>% 
      filter(task0!="Strategic") %>% 
      mutate(
        # feedback type 
        is_fpf = case_when(resptype_6 %in% c("Hit","CR") ~ "Correct (real)",
                           resptype_6 %in% c("FA (real)","Miss (real)") ~ "Incorrect",
                           resptype_6 %in% c("FA (FPF)","Miss (FPF)") ~ "Correct (FPF)",
                           .default=NA))
  }
  
  return(newdf)
}
```


```{r pool function}
# collapse cell means - use as needed for specified variables 
collapse_levels = function(df, vars=NULL,type=c("wave","amp"), contrast_var, cell_weight=TRUE) {
  
  if (is.null(vars)) {
    # enter custom list as needed (e.g. if collapsing across cond)
    vars = c("sub","cue_flip","cue","task0","task","cond","taskcond","time_ms",
             "df_type","erp_win","erp_chans")
    if (type=="amp") {
      vars = vars[vars!="time_ms"]
    }
  }
  
  # LONG format of contrast levels
  newdf = df %>% group_by(across(all_of(c(vars,contrast_var)))) %>% 
    summarise(mean_amp_unwt = mean(mean_amp, na.rm=TRUE),
              mean_amp_wt   = weighted.mean(mean_amp, cell_ntrials),
              cell_ntrials = sum(cell_ntrials),
              .groups="drop")  
  # sparse cells will be removed in `prep_diff_wave/amp`
  
  if (isFALSE(cell_weight)) {
    # requires a `mean_amp` column for next step
    # unweighted = averaging over subcells
    newdf$mean_amp = newdf$mean_amp_unwt
  } else if (isTRUE(cell_weight)) {
    # weighted by subcell ntrials
    newdf$mean_amp = newdf$mean_amp_wt
  } else (stop("Enter TRUE/FALSE for `cell_weight`"))
  
  return(newdf)   # should be sub x taskcond x `contrast_var` x `time_ms`
  # [!!!] MAY NEED ADDITIONAL FILTERING, e.g. if incorrect-correct contrast limited to non-FPF trials
  # this then goes into `prep_diff_wave/amp` 
  
}

```




```{r get resptype cell N for each epoch type}

get_cell_n = function(df, vars) {
  cell_n = df %>% group_by(across(all_of(vars))) %>% 
    filter(cell_ntrials >= min_n) %>% 
    summarise(ntrials_mean = mean(cell_ntrials), 
              ntrials_sd   = sd(cell_ntrials),
              ntrials_min  = min(cell_ntrials), 
              ntrials_max  = max(cell_ntrials),
              nsub_valid   = sum(cell_ntrials >= min_n), 
              .groups = "drop")
  return(cell_n)
}

get_cell_n(erpamp_df_list$FN400, vars = c("task","cond", "resptype")) 
get_cell_n(erpamp_df_list$ERN,   vars = c("task","cond", "resptype")) 
get_cell_n(erpamp_df_list$FRN,   vars = c("task","cond", "resptype_6"))  # no strategic
```

```{r plot diff function}

# BEFORE PLOTTING, filter out trials where `contrast_levels` values cover more than intended cells
# e.g. `resptype` probably does not need filtering; `is_correct` needs filtering when limiting to only FPF trials 

plot_custom_diff = function(erpwave_in, erpamp_in, curr_erpname, curr_title, 
                            contrast_var, contrast_levels, save_fig=F) {
  
  curr_win = erp_info$erp_win[erp_info$erp_name==curr_erpname][[1]]  # for full epoch wave window shading only
  
  diffwave_df1 = collapse_levels(erpwave_in, contrast_var=contrast_var, type="wave")   # long format of contrast levels
  diffwave_df2 = prep_erp_diffwave(diffwave_df1,contrast_var=contrast_var,contrast_levels=contrast_levels, avg=TRUE)  # grand average & wide format 
  print(
    plot_erp_diffwave(diffwave_df2, erp_win = curr_win, contrast_title = curr_title, save=save_fig)
  )
  
  diffamp_df1 = collapse_levels(erpamp_in, contrast_var=contrast_var, type="amp")
  diffamp_df2 = prep_erp_diffamp(diffamp_df1, contrast_var=contrast_var,contrast_levels=contrast_levels, avg=TRUE)
  print(
    plot_erp_diffamp(diffamp_df2, contrast_title = curr_title, save=save_fig)
  )
  
}
```

**SPECIFIC CONTRASTS BELOW**
```{r effsize function}

# get cohen's d
get_eff = function(model, model_contrast, type=c("within","between"), method=NULL, by=NULL) {
  # model object, contrast object, pairs list (optional)
  # within = within block (e.g. hit-cr within each taskcond; simple effects, interactions, single contrasts)
  # between = cross block (e.g. compare hit-cr effects across taskcond)
  sigma = sqrt(sum(as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))$vcov))   # standardizer for d [aka total SD]
  edf = df.residual(model)
  
  type = match.arg(type)
  if (type == "between") {
    model_contrast = contrast(model_contrast, by=by, method=method)  # inherit `by`
  }
  eff = eff_size(model_contrast, sigma=sigma, edf=edf, method="identity")
  
  return(eff)
}

```


```{r descriptives function}

get_des = function(df, vars, save=save_des, folder=NULL) {
  # df should be model df
  # produces raw cell M/SD averaged across subjects - will NOT be the same as model emmeans
  descriptives = df %>% 
    group_by(across(all_of(vars))) %>% 
    summarise(mean = mean(mean_amp, na.rm=TRUE), 
              sd   = sd(mean_amp, na.rm=TRUE), 
              nsub = n(), 
              .groups = "drop") 
  
  if (isTRUE(save)) {
    if (is.null(folder)) {
      folder = "/Users/lunarneko/Desktop/11_erp_stats/"
    }
    # e.g. des_stim_FzFCzCz_300_500_task_cond_resptype.csv
    filename = paste0(folder, "des_", unique(df$df_type), "_",
                      str_remove_all(unique(df$erp_chans), " "), "_",
                      str_replace_all(unique(df$erp_win), " ", "_"), "_",
                      paste(vars, collapse="_"), ".csv")
    
    write.csv(descriptives, filename, row.names=FALSE)
  }
  
  return(descriptives)
}

```

## FPF vs real correct, matched by resp old/new
- erp: FRN, P3 
- subset: FPF only, lib = FA FPF - hit; con = miss FPF - CR 
- collapse: is_fpf 
- diffwave/diffamp: FPF-cprrect 
- model: amp ~ cond * is_fpf 
- contrasts: lib FPF-correct; con FPF-correct; interaction [lib diff vs con diff]

```{r FRN, is_fpf}
# FRN
erpwave_in = erpwave_df_list$FRN %>% filter(task=="FPF") %>% 
  filter((cond=="Lib" & resptype_6 %in% c("Hit","FA (FPF)")) |
           (cond=="Con" & resptype_6 %in% c("CR","Miss (FPF)"))) %>% 
  mutate(cond = case_when(cond=="Lib" ~ glue("Lib (FA FPF{minus}Hit)"),
                          cond=="Con" ~ glue("Con (Miss FPF{minus}CR)"),
                          .default = NA)) 

erpamp_in  = erpamp_df_list$FRN  %>% filter(task=="FPF") %>% 
  filter((cond=="Lib" & resptype_6 %in% c("Hit","FA (FPF)")) |
           (cond=="Con" & resptype_6 %in% c("CR","Miss (FPF)"))) %>% 
  mutate(cond = case_when(cond=="Lib" ~ glue("Lib (FA FPF{minus}Hit)"),
                          cond=="Con" ~ glue("Con (Miss FPF{minus}CR)"),
                          .default = NA))

# ==== plot diff ===============================================================
plot_custom_diff(erpwave_in, erpamp_in, 
                 curr_erpname = "FRN", 
                 curr_title = glue("FPF{minus}Correct\nCondition-congruent responses"), 
                 contrast_var = "is_fpf", contrast_levels = c("Correct (FPF)","Correct (real)"), save_fig=save_fig)

# ==== model: cond x is_fpf ====================================================
diffamp_model_df = collapse_levels(erpamp_in, contrast_var="is_fpf", type="amp") %>% 
  filter(cell_ntrials >= min_n)

# raw descriptives for model data [NOT model emmeans]
get_des(diffamp_model_df, vars = c("taskcond", "is_fpf"))

model.lm = lmer(mean_amp ~ cond * is_fpf + (1|sub) + (1|sub:cond) + (1|sub:is_fpf), data=diffamp_model_df)
model.emm   = emmeans(model.lm, ~ is_fpf | cond, lmer.df = "satterthwaite")
model.pairs = pairs(model.emm)

model.emm; model.pairs 
get_eff(model = model.lm, model_contrast = model.pairs, type="within")

summary(model.pairs, by=NULL, adjust="holm", infer=c(T,T))
contrast_out = contrast(emmeans(model.lm, ~ is_fpf * cond, lmer.df = "satterthwaite"), 
                          adjust="holm", interaction="pairwise", infer=c(T,T)) -> FRN_isfpf_cond   # need this for later
contrast_out 
get_eff(model = model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_out, type="within") 

```

## control analysis, baseline only
- subset: baseline only
- model: amp ~ resptype [hit-cr; fa-miss]  

```{r FRN, baseline resptype}
# FRN
erpamp_in = erpamp_df_list$FRN  %>% filter(task=="Baseline") %>% filter(cell_ntrials >= min_n)
levels(erpamp_df_list$FRN$resptype)   # in this order: hit,fa,cr,miss

get_des(erpamp_in, vars = c("resptype"))

# ==== model: resptype =========================================================
model.lm = lmer(mean_amp ~ resptype + (1|sub), data=erpamp_in)
model.emm   = emmeans(model.lm, ~ resptype, lmer.df = "satterthwaite")
model.pairs = pairs(model.emm)
model.emm; model.pairs

# ===== contrasts ==============================================================
new_old_list = c(-0.5, 0.5, 0.5, -0.5)  # 0.5*(fa + cr) - 0.5*(hit + miss) [this is avg over fa - hit + cr - miss]
resptype_contrast = contrast(model.emm, list(new_old = new_old_list))
summary(resptype_contrast, by=NULL, adjust="holm", infer=c(TRUE, TRUE))
get_eff(model.lm, model_contrast=resptype_contrast, type="within")

# ===== compare with `is_fpf` effect ===========================================
eff1 = summary(FRN_isfpf_cond, infer=c(T,T))    
eff0 = summary(resptype_contrast, infer=c(T,T))

compare_isfpf_FRN = tibble(erp = "FRN",
                   eff1_lib_con = -eff1$estimate,   # output was con-lib, needs to flip sign here
                   eff0_item  = eff0$estimate, 
                   eff0_lower = eff0$lower.CL, 
                   eff0_upper = eff0$upper.CL,
                   corrected  = -eff1$estimate - 2*eff0$estimate,
                   worst_case = -eff1$estimate - 2*eff0$upper.CL)
compare_isfpf_FRN

```

# STIM 

### old/new memory effect, hit-CR 
- ERP: FN400, LPC 
- subset: hit/CR only 
- model: amp ~ taskcond x resptype[hit/cr] 
- contrast: ??
- erpwave/erpamp: full taskcond x resptype 
- diffwave/diffamp: hit-CR x taskcond 

```{r FN400, hit-cr}
# FN400
erpwave_in = erpwave_df_list$FN400 
erpamp_in  = erpamp_df_list$FN400 

# ==== plot diff ===============================================================
plot_custom_diff(erpwave_in, erpamp_in, 
                 curr_erpname = "FN400", 
                 curr_title = glue("Hit{minus}CR"), 
                 contrast_var = "resptype", contrast_levels = c("Hit","CR"), save_fig=save_fig)

# ==== model: taskcond x hitcr =================================================
diffamp_model_df = collapse_levels(erpamp_in, contrast_var="resptype", type="amp") %>% 
  filter(cell_ntrials >= min_n) %>% 
  filter(resptype %in% c("Hit","CR"))

get_des(diffamp_model_df, vars = c("task","cond","resptype"))

model.lm = lmer(mean_amp ~ taskcond * resptype * cue + (1|sub) + (1|sub:taskcond) + (1|sub:resptype), data=diffamp_model_df)
model.emm   = emmeans(model.lm, ~ resptype | taskcond*cue, lmer.df = "satterthwaite")
model.pairs = pairs(model.emm)

model.emm; model.pairs 

# ===== contrasts ============================================================== 
# [!!!] default order alphabetical: base, FPF con, FPF lib, strategic con, strategic lib 
# list specific contrasts so family-wise adjustment isn't too strict 
taskcond_pairs_list = list(
  fpfcon_fpflib = c( 0, 1,-1, 0, 0), scon_slib   = c( 0, 0, 0, 1,-1),  # lib vs con within each task
  fpfcon_base   = c(-1, 1, 0, 0, 0), scon_base   = c(-1, 0, 0, 1, 0),  # compare to baseline
  fpflib_base   = c(-1, 0, 1, 0, 0), slib_base   = c(-1, 0, 0, 0, 1),  
  fpflib_slib   = c( 0, 0, 1, 0,-1), fpfcon_scon = c( 0, 1, 0,-1, 0)   # FPF vs strategic within lib/con
)

contrast_hitcr = contrast(model.emm, list(hit_cr = c(1,-1)), adjust="holm")   # hit=1, cr=-1 [make sure factor levels are correct]
contrast_hitcr

# holm within each cue group
contrast(contrast_hitcr, by="cue", adjust = "holm", infer=c(T,T), method = taskcond_pairs_list)  # "none" for unadjusted pval
summary(contrast_hitcr, by="cue", adjust="holm", infer=c(T,T))

get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_hitcr, type="within")
get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_hitcr, type="between",by="cue", method=taskcond_pairs_list)

# full sample, averaged over cue [show base/FPF rows only]
contrast_hitcr_pooled = contrast(emmeans(model.lm, ~ resptype | taskcond, lmer.df = "satterthwaite"), list(hit_cr = c(1,-1)))
summary(contrast_hitcr_pooled[1:3], by=NULL, adjust="holm", infer=c(T,T))   # rows 1-3 = base, FPF con, FPF lib
contrast(contrast_hitcr_pooled, by=NULL, adjust="holm", infer=c(T,T), method = taskcond_pairs_list[c("fpfcon_fpflib","fpfcon_base","fpflib_base")])

get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_hitcr_pooled[1:3], type="within")
get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_hitcr_pooled, type="between", method=taskcond_pairs_list[c("fpfcon_fpflib","fpfcon_base","fpflib_base")])

# true vs reversed cue 
contrast(contrast_hitcr, by=NULL, adjust="holm", infer=c(T,T), method=cue_list[1:3]) # strategic
contrast(contrast_hitcr, by=NULL, adjust="none", infer=c(T,T), method=cue_list[4:5]) # consistency check, base/FPF
get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_hitcr, type="between", method=cue_list)

```

### FPF old/new item effect 
- erp: FN400, maybe LPC
- collapse: is_old 
- model: amp ~ cond x is_old 
- contrasts: new items lib-con; old items lib-con; interaction 
- [NEW] erpwave: is_old x libcon   *?????????????*
- diffwave/diffamp: lib-con, old and new items on separate panels [?????] 

```{r FN400, is_old}
# FN400
erpwave_in = erpwave_df_list$FN400 
erpamp_in  = erpamp_df_list$FN400 

# ==== plot diff ===============================================================
plot_custom_diff(erpwave_in, erpamp_in, 
                 curr_erpname = "FN400", 
                 curr_title = glue("Old{minus}New"), 
                 contrast_var = "is_old", contrast_levels = c("Old","New"), save_fig=save_fig)

# ==== model: all taskcond x is_old ============================================
diffamp_model_df = collapse_levels(erpamp_in, contrast_var="is_old", type="amp") %>% 
  filter(cell_ntrials >= min_n) %>% 
  mutate(is_old = factor(is_old, levels=c("Old","New")))  # specify levels for contrast order in model

get_des(diffamp_model_df, vars = c("task","cond","is_old"))

model.lm = lmer(mean_amp ~ taskcond * is_old * cue + (1|sub) + (1|sub:taskcond) + (1|sub:is_old), data=diffamp_model_df)
# replace `taskcond` with `task*cond` but need to get around empty cell issue from baseline
model.emm = emmeans(model.lm, ~ is_old | taskcond * cue, lmer.df = "satterthwaite")   # is there an old/new effect in each taskcond
model.pairs = pairs(model.emm)
model.emm; model.pairs 

# ===== contrasts ============================================================== 
# [!!!] default order alphabetical: base, FPF con, FPF lib, strategic con, strategic lib 
# list specific contrasts so family-wise adjustment isn't too strict 
taskcond_pairs_list = list(
  fpfcon_fpflib = c( 0, 1,-1, 0, 0), scon_slib   = c( 0, 0, 0, 1,-1),  # lib vs con within each task
  fpfcon_base   = c(-1, 1, 0, 0, 0), scon_base   = c(-1, 0, 0, 1, 0),  # compare to baseline
  fpflib_base   = c(-1, 0, 1, 0, 0), slib_base   = c(-1, 0, 0, 0, 1),  
  fpflib_slib   = c( 0, 0, 1, 0,-1), fpfcon_scon = c( 0, 1, 0,-1, 0)   # FPF vs strategic within lib/con
)

contrast_isold = contrast(model.emm, list(old_new = c(1,-1)), adjust="holm")   # old=1,new=-1 [make sure factor levels are correct]
contrast_isold

# within each cue group 
contrast(contrast_isold, by="cue", adjust = "holm", infer=c(T,T), method = taskcond_pairs_list)  # "none" for unadjusted pval
summary(contrast_isold, by="cue", adjust="holm", infer=c(T,T))

get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_isold, type="within")
get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_isold, type="between",by="cue", method=taskcond_pairs_list)


# full sample, averaged over cue [report base/FPF rows only]
contrast_isold_pooled = contrast(emmeans(model.lm, ~ is_old | taskcond, lmer.df = "satterthwaite"), list(old_new = c(1,-1)))
summary(contrast_isold_pooled[1:3], by=NULL, adjust="holm", infer=c(T,T))   # rows 1-3 = base, FPF con, FPF lib
contrast(contrast_isold_pooled, by=NULL, adjust="holm", infer=c(T,T), method = taskcond_pairs_list[c("fpfcon_fpflib","fpfcon_base","fpflib_base")])

get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_isold_pooled[1:3], type="within")
get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_isold_pooled, type="between", method=taskcond_pairs_list[c("fpfcon_fpflib","fpfcon_base","fpflib_base")])

# true vs reversed cue 
contrast(contrast_isold, by=NULL, adjust="holm", infer=c(T,T), method=cue_list[1:3])   # strategic
contrast(contrast_isold, by=NULL, adjust="none", infer=c(T,T), method=cue_list[4:5])   # consistency check, base/FPF
get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_isold, type="between", method=cue_list)

# ==== model: cond x is_old, FPF only ==========================================
diffamp_model_df = collapse_levels(erpamp_in %>% filter(task=="FPF"), 
                                   contrast_var="is_old", type="amp") %>% 
  filter(cell_ntrials >= min_n) %>% 
  mutate(is_old = factor(is_old, levels=c("Old","New")),
         cond   = factor(cond,   levels=c("Lib","Con")))   

get_des(diffamp_model_df, vars = c("taskcond","is_old"))

model.lm = lmer(mean_amp ~ cond * is_old + (1|sub) + (1|sub:cond) + (1|sub:is_old), data=diffamp_model_df)
model.emm   = emmeans(model.lm, ~ is_old | cond, lmer.df = "satterthwaite")  # old-new within each cond
model.pairs = pairs(model.emm)
model.emm; model.pairs 

model.emm2   = emmeans(model.lm, ~ cond | is_old, lmer.df = "satterthwaite")  # lib-con within each status
model.pairs2 = pairs(model.emm2)
model.emm2; model.pairs2 

summary(model.pairs2, by=NULL, adjust="holm", infer=c(T,T))
contrast_out = contrast(emmeans(model.lm, ~ is_old * cond, lmer.df = "satterthwaite"), 
         adjust="holm", interaction="pairwise", infer=c(T,T)) 
contrast_out

get_eff(model = model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_out, type="within")

```

# RESP  

### overall error effect
- erp: ERN

- diff: incorrect-correct

- diffwave/diffamp: diff x taskcond 


```{r ERN, is_correct}
# ERN
erpwave_in = erpwave_df_list$ERN

                 contrast_var = "is_correct", contrast_levels = c("Incorrect","Correct"), save_fig=save_fig)

# ==== model: taskcond x is_correct ============================================

  filter(cell_ntrials >= min_n) %>% 
  mutate(is_correct = factor(is_correct, levels=c("Incorrect","Correct")))

get_des(diffamp_model_df, vars = c("task","cond","is_correct"))

model.lm = lmer(mean_amp ~ taskcond * is_correct * cue + (1|sub) + (1|sub:taskcond) + (1|sub:is_correct), data=diffamp_model_df)
model.emm   = emmeans(model.lm, ~ is_correct | taskcond * cue, lmer.df = "satterthwaite")
model.pairs = pairs(model.emm)
model.emm; model.pairs 

# ===== contrasts ============================================================== 
# [!!!] default order alphabetical: base, FPF con, FPF lib, strategic con, strategic lib 
# list specific contrasts so family-wise adjustment isn't too strict 
taskcond_pairs_list = list(
  fpfcon_fpflib = c( 0, 1,-1, 0, 0), scon_slib   = c( 0, 0, 0, 1,-1),  # lib vs con within each task
  fpfcon_base   = c(-1, 1, 0, 0, 0), scon_base   = c(-1, 0, 0, 1, 0),  # compare to baseline
  fpflib_base   = c(-1, 0, 1, 0, 0), slib_base   = c(-1, 0, 0, 0, 1),  
  fpflib_slib   = c( 0, 0, 1, 0,-1), fpfcon_scon = c( 0, 1, 0,-1, 0)   # FPF vs strategic within lib/con
)

contrast_iscorrect = contrast(model.emm, list(incorrect_correct = c(1,-1)), adjust="holm")   # incorrect=1, correct=-1 [make sure factor levels are correct]
contrast_iscorrect

# within each cue group
contrast(contrast_iscorrect, by="cue", adjust="holm", infer=c(T,T), method = taskcond_pairs_list)  # "none" for unadjusted pval
summary(contrast_iscorrect, by="cue", adjust="holm", infer=c(T,T))

get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_iscorrect, type="within")
get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_iscorrect, type="between",by="cue", method=taskcond_pairs_list)


# full sample, averaged over cue [report base/FPF rows only]

summary(contrast_iscorrect_pooled[1:3], by=NULL, adjust="holm", infer=c(T,T))   # rows 1-3 = base, FPF con, FPF lib
contrast(contrast_iscorrect_pooled, by=NULL, adjust="holm", infer=c(T,T), method = taskcond_pairs_list[c("fpfcon_fpflib","fpfcon_base","fpflib_base")])

get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_iscorrect_pooled[1:3], type="within")
get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_iscorrect_pooled, type="between", method=taskcond_pairs_list[c("fpfcon_fpflib","fpfcon_base","fpflib_base")])

# true vs reversed cue

contrast(contrast_iscorrect, by=NULL, adjust="none", infer=c(T,T), method=cue_list[4:5])   # consistency check, base/FPF
get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = contrast_iscorrect, type="between", method=cue_list)
```

### overall bias effect / criterion condition effect 
- erp: ERN 
- collapse: sayold/saynew
- subset: strategic/FPF only 
- diffwave/diffamp: sayold-saynew x task, lib/con overlaid within task 

```{r ERN, say_old}
# ERN
erpwave_in = erpwave_df_list$ERN 
erpamp_in  = erpamp_df_list$ERN 

# ==== plot diff ===============================================================
plot_custom_diff(erpwave_in, erpamp_in, 
                 curr_erpname = "ERN", 
                 curr_title = glue("\"Old\"{minus}\"New\" responses"), 
                 contrast_var = "say_old", contrast_levels = c("Old","New"), save_fig=save_fig)

# ==== model: task x cond x say_old, strategic/FPF only ========================
diffamp_model_df = collapse_levels(erpamp_in %>% filter(task!="Baseline"), 
                                   contrast_var="say_old", type="amp") %>% 
  filter(cell_ntrials >= min_n) %>% 
  mutate(say_old = factor(say_old, levels=c("Old","New")),
         cond    = factor(cond, levels=c("Lib","Con")))

get_des(diffamp_model_df, vars = c("task","cond","say_old"))

model.lm = lmer(mean_amp ~ task0 * cond * say_old * cue + (1|sub) + (1|sub:taskcond) + (1|sub:say_old), data=diffamp_model_df)
model.emm   = emmeans(model.lm, ~ say_old * cond | task0 * cue, lmer.df = "satterthwaite") 
model.pairs = pairs(model.emm)
model.emm; model.pairs 

# cond x response within each task, by cue group
eff_within   = contrast(emmeans(model.lm, ~ say_old * cond | task0 * cue, 
                                lmer.df = "satterthwaite"), interaction = "pairwise")
# FPF vs strategic, by cue group
eff_taskcond = contrast(emmeans(model.lm, ~ say_old * cond * task0 | cue, 
                                lmer.df = "satterthwaite"), interaction = "pairwise")
# true vs reversed, by task [FPF = consistency check]
eff_cue      = contrast(emmeans(model.lm, ~ say_old * cond * cue | task0,   
                                lmer.df = "satterthwaite"), interaction = "pairwise")
# full sample, averaged over cue [report FPF row only]
eff_pooled   = contrast(emmeans(model.lm, ~ say_old * cond | task0,         
                                lmer.df = "satterthwaite"), interaction = "pairwise")

summary(eff_within, by="cue", infer=c(T,T), adjust="holm")
summary(eff_taskcond,         infer=c(T,T))
summary(eff_cue,              infer=c(T,T))
summary(eff_pooled,           infer=c(T,T))

get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = eff_within,   type="within")
get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = eff_taskcond, type="within")
get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = eff_cue,      type="within")
get_eff(model=model.lm, model_contrast = eff_pooled,   type="within")

```

# ERP-behavior correlations 
- diffamp for F2, S2

- FRN, FPF lib only, [FA FPF - hit] ~ [FPF lib c - baseline c???]
- FRN diff (same as ^) ~ [strategic cshift] (distinct mechanisms predicts no relationship)
- FN400, FPF only, [old-new effect lib-con diff] ~ [FPF cshift]

```{r ERP-behavior}

cshift = read.csv("../../data_code_beh/subj_summary/cshift.csv") %>% rename(sub=subID)  
sdt_base = read.csv("../../data_code_beh/subj_summary/sdt_baseline.csv") %>% rename(sub=subID)  

c_fpf_base = cshift %>% filter(task=="FPF") %>% 
  select(sub,task,cshift,Lib) %>% rename(c2 = Lib) %>% 
  bind_rows(sdt_base %>% select(sub,task,c2)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from=task,values_from=c(c2,cshift)) %>% select(-cshift_Baseline) %>% 
  rename(c2_FPF_lib = c2_FPF) %>% 
  mutate(fpf_base_cdiff = c2_FPF_lib - c2_Baseline)  # difference in c during FPF lib compared to baseline

# FRN effects 
fpf_lib_hitfa_FRN = erpamp_df_list$FRN  %>% filter(task=="FPF" & cond=="Lib") %>% 
  filter((cond=="Lib" & resptype_6 %in% c("Hit","FA (FPF)"))) %>% 
  filter(cell_ntrials >= min_n) %>% 
  mutate(cond = case_when(cond=="Lib" ~ glue("Lib (FA FPF{minus}Hit)"),
                          .default = NA)) %>% 
  prep_erp_diffamp(contrast_var = "resptype_6", contrast_levels=c("FA (FPF)","Hit"), avg=FALSE) %>% 
  merge(c_fpf_base, by="sub") 

cor.test(fpf_lib_hitfa_FRN$diff, fpf_lib_hitfa_FRN$fpf_base_cdiff)  # FRN effect ~ lib FPF cshift relative to baseline
cor.test(fpf_lib_hitfa_FRN$diff, fpf_lib_hitfa_FRN$c2_FPF_lib)      # FRN effect ~ lib FPF c

cshift_strategic_FRN = cshift %>% filter(task0=="Strategic") %>% 
  rename(strategic_con = Con, 
         strategic_lib = Lib,
         strategic_cshift = cshift) %>% 
  select(sub, strategic_con, strategic_lib, strategic_cshift) %>% 
  merge(fpf_lib_hitfa_FRN, by="sub")

# FRN effect ~ strategic cshift, by cue group [sanity check, should have NO relationship]
cor.test(~ diff+strategic_cshift, data = cshift_strategic_FRN %>% filter(cue=="True"))
cor.test(~ diff+strategic_cshift, data = cshift_strategic_FRN %>% filter(cue=="Reversed"))

# FN400 old-new effects
fpf_oldnew_FN400 = collapse_levels(erpamp_df_list$FN400 %>% filter(task == "FPF"),
                                   contrast_var="is_old", type="amp") %>%   
  filter(cell_ntrials >= min_n) %>%
  select(sub, cond, is_old, mean_amp) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(cond, is_old), values_from = mean_amp) %>%   
  mutate(lib_oldnew = Lib_Old - Lib_New,
         con_oldnew = Con_Old - Con_New,
         oldnew_libcon = lib_oldnew - con_oldnew) %>%   # FN400 diff in diff: is old/new effect larger in lib or con
  filter(!is.na(oldnew_libcon)) %>% 
  merge(cshift %>% filter(task=="FPF"), by="sub") %>% 
  rename(FPF_con = Con,
         FPF_lib = Lib,
         FPF_cshift = cshift)

cor.test(fpf_oldnew_FN400$oldnew_libcon, fpf_oldnew_FN400$FPF_cshift)  # lib-con diff in old-new diff ~ FPF cshift

```


```{r plot corr}
library(ggpmisc)

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "lightgray") +

  ggpmisc::stat_correlation(mapping = use_label(c("R", "P", "n")), small.r=TRUE, small.p=TRUE, size=3) +
  labs(x = glue("Liberal FPF effect at FRN\nFA (FPF){minus}Hit (µV)"), y=glue("Strategic {Delta}c")) +
  theme_bw(base_size=10)
```
